title: MORNING BUILDS SLOW
style:
92 BPM — Tropical Acoustic / Island Folk / Café Groove

STYLE TAGS

92 BPM, nylon-string guitar rhythmic plucks,
soft shaker groove,
warm upright bass,
marimba sparkle mid-song,
layered harmony vocals,
instrumental lift before final chorus,
gentle fade outro,
light, optimistic, tropical acoustic
lyrics:
[Intro – Soft spoken English]
It always starts small.

[Verse 1 – English]
One cup poured, one chair pulled
One quiet story waiting to be told
Morning doesn’t rush the tide
It rises slow, then opens wide

[Pre-Chorus – Tagalog]
Unti-unti, lumalakas ang ilaw
(Little by little, the light grows stronger)
Tahimik pero siguradong galaw
(Quiet but surely moving)

[Chorus – English + Tagalog]
Morning builds slow, then it shines
Kape at araw, perfect lines
Sama-sama, kahit ilan
(Together, however many we become)
From one small spark, the day is won

[Verse 2 – Cebuano + English]
Gamay nga sugod, dako nga damgo
(Small beginning, big dream)
Init sa buntag, steady ang ritmo
(Morning warmth, steady rhythm)

From one follow to a crowd
From quiet hope to singing loud

[Bridge – Instrumental lift + Spoken]
Guitar rises
Marimba answers
Bass steady

Spoken:
We didn’t need a thousand.
We just needed one.

[Final Chorus – Full harmony]
Morning builds slow, now it glows
Island rhythm, everyone knows
Steam in the air, sky so wide
We’re just getting started — ride the tide

[Outro – Soft Tagalog whisper]
Salamat sa simula.
(Thank you for the beginning.)

Fade to guitar only.
